purpose: Original exterior direction studies, not validated hardware

variants.name: Nucleus
variants.description: A compact circular top, concentrated green status annulus, smooth shoulders, the closest of the four to a restrained power-ring impression.
variants.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create an exquisite original industrial design concept presentation for INFINITY RING, a future AI wearable ring. This round is about HARDWARE EXTERIOR DESIGN, not a website and not a UI. High-end photorealistic product design visualization, horizontal 3:2 landscape composition, very high detail. Consistent nearly black charcoal studio background, broad white studio reflections, graphite titanium brushed satin surfaces, a few polished machined edges, extremely restrained clear emerald-green functional light. Important: this is a modern daily-wear finger ring concept with a visible hollow band and a narrowed comfortable underside, NOT a large theatrical prop. User takes inspiration from the sense of power and green activation of Hal Jordan's ring in the live-action Lanterns series; create an ORIGINAL contemporary wearable with no Green Lantern insignia, no superhero symbol, no crystal gemstone, no magical glow or floating particles. More futuristic and distinctive than a plain cylindrical wedding band, but refined and wearable. The top can be moderately wider and thicker than the underside to indicate room for unvalidated prospective optics. There should be two small dark inset forward-facing optical windows at the distal edge, one for a proposed camera and one for proposed targeting optics, not huge camera lenses protruding at the wearer. Rotation control is expressed with a fine usable grip seam. No numeric dimensions, no battery specifications, no availability claims, no internal assembly proof.
Layout: LEFT roughly 65% is one large impressive three-quarter floating product view showing the top design and inner band clearly, completely within frame, soft elliptical ground shadow. RIGHT top a smaller clean side/profile view of EXACTLY THE SAME DESIGN, right bottom a small restrained photographic on-hand view of the SAME ring worn near the base of an adult index finger, relaxed natural hand with correct anatomy and moderate ring scale. The product design identity and green features must stay consistent in all three views. Generous breathing space and very thin dividing rules, like a premium industrial design portfolio sheet. Do not label photography as actual production hardware. All text limited to tiny exact labels as specified. Use elegant small uppercase white technical typography. Do not print big concept copy, feature callouts, or fake measurements.
DESIGN R1 / NUCLEUS: A low-profile softened circular crown smoothly integrated into an otherwise tapering graphite titanium band, a modern reduced signet shape. The crown is only slightly wider than the upper band, not a huge disk sitting on a thin ring. Its center is flat satin dark graphite metal with NO emblem or engraving. A very fine recessed emerald annular status light encircles that dark center, inside a beautifully machined raised metal protective lip. The green is a thin precise light line, not a solid gemstone or glowing face. A faint off-center concentric machining circle in the metal adds purposeful precision. Smooth sculpted shoulders flow downward into the slimmer underside. Rotary input is a thin ridged edge on the circular crown; the crown visually indicates turn interaction. Two separate tiny forward-facing black optical windows are integrated on the front rim below the circular crown. Make it feel like an elegant precise instrument with a calm center of power, subtle futuristic presence, luxurious graphite titanium. This is the ROUND, SCULPTED member of the four.
Exact labels: top-left 'INFINITY RING'; below small 'R1 / NUCLEUS'; right top 'PROFILE'; right lower 'ON HAND'; bottom-left 'EXTERIOR CONCEPT / 01'.

DESIGN R2 / VECTOR: A sleek aerodynamic chamfered octagonal wedge-shaped top integrated continuously into the metal band, NOT a round crown. Distinct low-profile asymmetric hard-surface design: two long planar graphite faces meet at a precise shallow ridge, with wide elegant bevels catching light; the shoulders taper into a smooth rounded underside. One short thin oblique emerald light slash sits within a recessed seam near the top's right side, no full circle of light. A small dark smoked-sapphire slit occupies the leading bevel with two inset optical openings, almost flush. Rotary outer band is articulated as a fine staggered mechanical belt around the ring circumference, with a narrow grip segment visible on one shoulder. Only two or three purposeful facets, no busy greebles or exposed screws; quiet stealth-machine elegance, futuristic but not militaristic armor or a toy. Keep the silhouette notably thinner at the sides. This is the ANGULAR, DIRECTIONAL member of the four, clearly unlike a round signet or cylindrical band.

A small circular deeply recessed smoke-black optical-like center, surrounded by two thin concentric machining tracks and an interrupted emerald status arc; the central aperture itself stays dark, no gemstone. A flush finely knurled dial around the inset circle suggests beautiful physical rotation. A brushed titanium sloped frame cradles the dial, transitioning to streamlined shoulders and a slim rounded underside. Detail of restrained optical iris-shaped internal metal segments may be visible through the smoked top window but remain sober mechanical detail, not a glowing flower. Two modest functional forward-facing dark optical windows sit at the leading side of the frame; the top circle is a conceptual control/status surface, do not make a huge lens. This variant should look like a precision miniature tool from a premium optical instrument brand, crisp engineered concentricity, strong craftsmanship and technologically sophisticated depth. This is the CONCENTRIC, PRECISION-DIAL member of the four, distinct from R1's smooth flat center and R2's wedge.
Exact labels: top-left 'INFINITY RING'; below small 'R3 / IRIS'; right top 'PROFILE'; right lower 'ON HAND'; bottom-left 'EXTERIOR CONCEPT / 03'.

variants.name: Orbit
variants.description: Two structural rails around a dark central band, light in an interrupted seam; strongest layering for separation animation.

DESIGN R4 / ORBIT: A sophisticated split-rail ring silhouette with two slim continuous sculpted titanium structural rails framing a darker recessed central rotating band. NO circular signet crown, NO raised rectangular top plate. At the top the two rails broaden gently and connect with one subtle off-center titanium bridge over the middle band, forming a low arch with a small intentional negative-space slot; not an open gap that would expose imaginary electronics. The central band is a graphite black fine-textured control surface; one interrupted very thin emerald light trace follows about a quarter of its circumference, visible only between the outer rails. It should appear like a refined layered technical sculpture, with the top bridge shielding two tiny flush black forward optical windows. Rounded inner liner and thin lower band clearly support comfort. The whole object remains a continuous wearable ring with restrained complexity and original asymmetry. Delicate interlocking stepped seams suggest eventual mechanical separation in a website animation without actually showing exploded parts here. This is the LAYERED, ARCHITECTURAL member of the four, clearly distinct from round crowns, wedges and optical dials. Premium high-tech jewelry, not a spaceship or armor.
Exact labels: top-left 'INFINITY RING'; below small 'R4 / ORBIT'; right top 'PROFILE'; right lower 'ON HAND'; bottom-left 'EXTERIOR CONCEPT / 04'.
